chunks: And the night when it grows still
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'And the night when it grows still' mean in Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is frequently cited as part of the 'Muqatta'at' or divine oaths, where the 'quieting' of the night (saja) symbolizes the transition from chaos to order, reflecting the divine attribute of Hikmah (wisdom). Scholars like Allamah Tabatabai interpret this stillness as a sign of God's control over cosmic rhythms, urging believers to reflect on the transient nature of worldly states versus eternal truth.
